title: The six new repositories have not deployed: set each one's Pages source to 'Deploy from a branch: dev, / (root)' (or a deploy workflow, through security), then dev checks every site live
note: No Pages build has run in any of them (25 October, evening: each host answers 'Site not found'; the main site's staging name is site.php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai, as its DNS record has it).
